stories.title: AppSheet Alcance_OT field type — decide link vs file upload, implement chosen approach
stories.context: Both approaches PROVEN VIABLE on TEST OT 2026-05-25: text writes to Alcance_OT persist (link approach), AND base64 PDF uploads succeed (AppSheet transforms data URL into native file reference). The choice depends on (a) whether we can stand up a permanent auth-gated route in dashboard for the link, (b) whether Jose's team can/will share the AppSheet backing Drive folder with HR users (required for file widget download).
stories.decision_required_before_implementation: Must be made WITH Irina (and ideally Jose) at session start. Do not pick unilaterally — has product implications for Jose's mobile UX.

A.name: Durable link in text-typed Alcance_OT column
A.approach: Stand up dashboard route /api/alcance/[ot_id] that streams the latest alcance PDF from Supabase Storage with auth (or use a long-lived signed URL refreshed by projector on re-finalize)
pros: Always serves current version (re-finalize → same link)
Works on any device (laptop browser, mobile)
cons: Need to build + maintain the route
Auth model TBD (public bucket vs signed URL vs OAuth)
If link format changes, all AppSheet rows need re-writeback
A.implementation_sketch: 1. Build dashboard/src/app/api/alcance/[ot_id]/route.ts that fetches alcance_pdf_path from ots_extended, streams the bytes from Supabase Storage. 2. Update sync/src/projector.ts buildAlcanceOtValue to return the dashboard URL string instead of text-with-PDF-path. 3. Re-queue 3 OTs (Ht6..., 1Bt..., LK4...) to back-fill.

B.name: PDF file upload to file-typed Alcance_OT column
B.approach: Update projector to download PDF from Supabase Storage, base64-encode, write as data:application/pdf;base64,... — proven works on TEST OT
pros: PDF survives in Jose's universe even if marketplace dashboard goes down
Mobile-friendly inline preview in AppSheet app
cons: Requires Drive folder sharing (Jose action) for HR users to download from web UI
B.implementation_sketch: 1. Modify sync/src/projector.ts buildAlcanceOtValue to: download PDF via supa.storage.from('alcance-photos').download(pdfPath), Buffer to base64, return 'data:application/pdf;base64,'+b64. 2. Re-queue 3 OTs to back-fill. 3. Coordinate with Jose to share AppSheet backing Drive folder.

stories.title: Architect auto-prompt on OT state-4 transition (real-time webhook OR daily cron fallback)
stories.context: Pre-2026-05-26 the architect had no automatic trigger to scope a new state-4 OT — the only prompts were (a) architect remembering on their own, or (b) HR clicking the 'pedir alcance al arquitecto' button (wrong domain owner per §9.9 reasoning). This story moves the trigger to where it belongs: the system itself, listening to AppSheet state transitions. HR dashboard becomes pure observability (kept in S11).
stories.decision_required_before_implementation: Pick webhook path vs cron fallback based on Jose's answers to the 3 open questions in PRD §9.9. Webhook is preferred (real-time); cron is the fallback if AppSheet bots unavailable. Do NOT pick unilaterally — paths have different operational profiles for Jose's team.

A.name: Real-time AppSheet webhook (preferred)
A.approach: Jose configures an AppSheet bot: trigger on Ordenes_Trabajo row update where Estado newly starts with '4.', action = HTTP POST to dashboard endpoint. Dashboard endpoint validates HMAC, checks ots_extended.alcance_jsonb, if NULL enqueues Manos outbound message with scheduled_at = next 07:00 America/Bogota for humane delivery.
pros: Single source of truth (AppSheet IS the state change)
cons: Requires Jose to configure 1 bot (~10min one-time)
Depends on AppSheet bot service uptime
Requires Core plan or above (paid feature)
A.implementation_sketch: 1. Add migration 017_outbound_messages_scheduled_at.sql: ADD COLUMN scheduled_at timestamptz, index on (status, scheduled_at) WHERE status='pending'. 2. Update manos/src/outbound.ts drainer query: ...AND (scheduled_at IS NULL OR scheduled_at <= now()). 3. Build dashboard/src/app/api/appsheet-hooks/ot-state-4/route.ts: validate HMAC (shared secret in env APPSHEET_HOOK_SECRET), parse body, query ots_extended, compose architect message using arquitectos_mirror.Telefono + Nombre, compute scheduled_at via date-fns-tz, INSERT outbound_messages, log to eventos as architect_alcance_prompt. 4. Coordinate with Jose to add the bot pointing at the new endpoint.

B.name: Daily cron fallback at 06:30 America/Bogota
B.approach: If AppSheet bots unavailable: cron job in sync workspace runs daily at 06:30 Bogota. SELECT state-4 OTs LEFT JOIN ots_extended WHERE alcance_jsonb IS NULL, group by ID_Arquitecto, send one consolidated message per architect listing all their pending OTs.
pros: Predictable rhythm (architect knows morning queue is the standup)
Consolidated batched delivery = less notification noise
cons: Up to 24h latency (counting 15min mirror lag, up to 24h15min)
Daily SELECT cost (negligible at v1 scale)
B.implementation_sketch: 1. Add scheduled_at migration (same as Option A — useful for future). 2. New file sync/src/architect-daily-prompt.ts: query, group, format consolidated body, INSERT one outbound_messages row per architect (kind='text', channel='manos'), INSERT eventos per OT for audit + idempotency. 3. Wire cron in sync/src/runner.ts: cron.schedule('30 6 * * *', runDailyArchitectPrompt, { timezone: 'America/Bogota' }). 4. Dry-run smoke first (TONO_DEV_INJECT-style print-don't-send), then live.

stories.title: Duplicate-question bug — secondary dedup on phone+text+recent-window
stories.context: Observed in two consecutive live WA tests on 2026-05-28: Juan Pablo (14:48 PT) and Irina Vélez López (15:27 PT). Toño re-emits the same question 9-11s after the first emission with slightly different wording — second message often opens with 'Dale, pero te preguntaba otra cosa' implying the LLM thought its prior turn was misunderstood, even though the user's answer was correct. In Juan's case: DB-confirmed two distinct outbound_messages rows. In Irina's case: same pattern on 'mándame dos fotos de tu cédula' at 15:27:04 + 15:27:15. Code-path analysis (tono/src/whatsapp.ts handleIncoming → enqueue → flushBatch idempotent; tono/src/agent.ts handleMessage single-emission; tono/src/runner.ts sendAgentReply only on success-path; tono/src/llm.ts runTurn returns ONE reply at iteration where toolUseBlocks.length===0) proves the code guarantees ONE outbound per logical inbound. So the only remaining mechanism is WhatsApp/Baileys re-delivering the same user input with a different msg.key.id, which defeats the existing dedup at whatsapp.ts:254 (seenMessageIds set keyed by msg.key.id only).
acceptance_criteria: tono/src/whatsapp.ts handleIncoming gains a secondary dedup: keep a recentTextByPhone Map<phone, {text, at}>; before enqueueing, if last.text === incoming text AND now - last.at < 3000ms, drop with log.warn('dropped likely retransmission (phone+text+3s)')

Dedup applies ONLY to text messages (not media — photos with same caption may legitimately repeat); window is 3000ms (long enough to absorb network retransmission, short enough that intentional 'sí sí' or repeat-typing isn't blocked)
Existing seenMessageIds dedup at line 254 kept as primary; new dedup is belt-and-suspenders for the cases where msg.key.id differs
Add observability: every inbound handleIncoming logs {phone, msgId, text_preview, dedup_decision} so future duplicate diagnostics have evidence
Smoke test: simulate two enqueue() calls with same phone+text within 1s — second is dropped with log; same phone+text 5s apart — both processed; same phone different text within 1s — both processed
Live re-test on phone +137877543452841 with intentional short-answer questions ('6', 'sí', 'no') — confirm no duplicate emission within 10s
npm run typecheck passes
evidence_pre_fix: DB queries against outbound_messages for both phones confirm two distinct rows per duplicate

stories.title: Grounding gate facts whitelist — absorb just-registered nombre + domain terms
stories.context: Live test 2026-05-28 (Juan Pablo) emitted 3 grounding_violation_logged eventos in a 4-minute span flagging spurious 'ungrounded' tokens: (1) 21:47:05 flagged 'Juan' and 'Pablo' as proper nouns not in grounded facts — but these are the user's OWN just-registered name; (2) 21:49:29 flagged 'RETIE', 'SISO', 'Seguridad', 'Salud', 'Trabajo' as ungrounded — these are Colombian construction-industry safety certifications Toño legitimately asks about during screening; (3) 21:50:17 flagged 'ARL', 'EPS' — Colombian payroll/insurance abbreviations Toño legitimately asks about. The grounding gate is currently log-only (TONO_GROUNDING_ENFORCE defaults to false) so no user impact, but the noise hides real hallucinations. The gate is implemented in tono/src/grounding-gate.ts and called from tono/src/agent.ts:811. Two fixes are needed: (a) the GroundedFacts struct passed at agent.ts:803 must include the worker's nombre from session_identity / register_tecnico tool output, and (b) a static whitelist of domain terms (RETIE, SISO, ARL, EPS, COP, IVA, NIT, RUT, plus screening-context terms 'Seguridad', 'Salud', 'Trabajo' when they appear in compound 'Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo') must be added to grounding-gate.ts so the gate doesn't flag them.
acceptance_criteria: tono/src/grounding-gate.ts gains DOMAIN_TERMS_WHITELIST: Set<string> = {'RETIE', 'SISO', 'ARL', 'EPS', 'COP', 'IVA', 'NIT', 'RUT', 'Seguridad', 'Salud', 'Trabajo', 'Redin'}; checkGrounding() filters these out before reporting violations
GroundedFacts now includes nombre (string|null) and nombre_parts (string[]) derived from nombre.split(/\s+/); checkGrounding treats every nombre part as a grounded proper noun
tono/src/agent.ts at line ~803 builds groundedFacts with nombre from session_identity (preferred) OR most recent register_tecnico tool result OR tecnicos_extended.nombre lookup (fallback)

Re-test Juan's exact scenario (register as 'Juan Pablo X', then have Toño ask SISO/RETIE/ARL/EPS questions): zero grounding_violation_logged eventos in the 4-minute window. If real hallucinations occur (e.g., LLM invents a placa or address), they STILL fire — only the listed false positives are suppressed
npm run typecheck passes
files_expected: tono/src/agent.ts (GroundedFacts construction at the gate-call site)
evidence_pre_fix: data/test-results-tono/May28-juanpablo-tono.txt session 8a6e5342: 3 grounding_violation_logged events at 21:47:05, 21:49:29, 21:50:17 UTC, flagging Juan/Pablo/RETIE/SISO/ARL/EPS/Seguridad/Salud/Trabajo
